historical_commentary.text: The Replicator library described here is a bespoke, era-specific solution that has almost certainly been superseded by 4D's own later synchronization/replication features and ORDA-based remote datastore access, though the basic principles of data replication it introduces remain foundational and still applicable today.
related_updates: 4D has since added more built-in synchronization/replication capabilities than existed via this third-party-style Replicator library in 2003
